summary: JS SDK monorepo build and test infrastructure — workspace test runner, MSW API mocks, edge-compat enforcement, and TypeScript declaration fixups that make the SDK reliable across runtimes and module systems.

intentions.title: Ship a runtime-agnostic SDK that runs in Node, edge workers (Cloudflare workerd), and browsers without modification
intentions.evidence: vitest.workspace.ts configures three distinct test pools (node, core-workerd/miniflare, react-browser/playwright); check-no-node-imports.sh enforces ADR-002 — no node: imports in core or nextjs edge subpaths

intentions.title: Keep TypeScript declaration files correct for all modern module resolution strategies (Bundler, NodeNext, CJS)
intentions.evidence: post-build-dts.mjs copies .d.ts → .d.mts post-tsup so consumers using moduleResolution:Bundler or NodeNext get correct import.types; preserves .d.cts for CJS fallback

intentions.title: Enable fast, network-free unit tests against the Barkpark HTTP API contract
intentions.evidence: test-utils/msw/handlers.ts mocks /v1/meta, /v1/schemas/:dataset, /v1/data/query, /v1/data/doc, and /v1/data/mutate; server.ts + vitest.setup.ts wire MSW lifecycle (listen/reset/close) globally across the suite
